title: The Definitive B2B Data API Resource for Technical and Business Users
summary: What a B2B data API is, how intelligence and integration APIs differ, and how AI agents get company and people data through REST, MCP or a CLI.
body_markdown: Nithish explores how real-time signals are reshaping B2B growth from identifying the right prospects and candidates to finding promising companies before the market sees them. At Crustdata, they help translate people and company data into practical use cases for sales teams, recruiters, and investors looking to make faster, more confident decisions.
